name: MobileNetV2 Food-101
export_note: Re-exported from the published epoch-27 checkpoint with model.eval() and ONNX opset 17.
preprocessing: Resize shorter side to 256, center crop 224, ImageNet normalization
limitations: Recognizes only the 101 Food-101 dish classes.
A photo may contain several foods but the model performs single-label classification.
Confidence is not a medical or nutrition certainty score.
The model cannot determine ingredients, allergens, portion size, cooking oil, or exact nutrients.
Every result must be confirmed against the nutrition database before logging.
